     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.SectionsBaseChange
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Degree
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Base-change instances for the curve over an extension field (gap G-D5(a))
    11	
    12	For the challenge curve `C : Over (Spec k)` (smooth of relative dimension one, proper and
    13	geometrically irreducible over the field `k`) and a field extension `K` of `k`
    14	(`[Field K] [Algebra k K]`), this file installs — **as instances that fire by typeclass
    15	resolution** — every hypothesis of the landed degree/Riemann–Roch stack
    16	(`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Degree`) for the base-changed curve
    17	
    18	`C_K := (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left`,
    19	
    20	viewed as a `K`-scheme via the **second projection** `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`. This is
    21	exactly the `Over`-instance spelling that `Cohomology.RelativeTwoCover.relCurve.instOver`
    22	uses (`.ofHom (snd C (overSpec k K)).left`), but keyed on the `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left`
    23	spelling that the Riemann–Roch files consume, rather than on the `relCurve C K` `def`.
    24	
    25	The single geometric input is the pullback bridge `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`
    26	(`Cohomology.SectionsBaseChange`): the second projection `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left` is the
    27	base change of the structure morphism `C.hom` along `overSpec k K ⟶ Spec k`. Every morphism
    28	property then transports by `MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange` (smooth of relative
    29	dimension one, proper, geometrically irreducible), and integrality of `C_K` is
    30	`isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced` applied to the base change (geometric
    31	irreducibility is transported; geometric reducedness comes for free from smoothness).
    32	
    33	## Main instances (keyed for the Riemann–Roch stack)
    34	
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instOverBaseChange` — item 1: `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` is a `K`-scheme
    36	  via the second projection; `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec K = (snd C (overSpec k K)).left`
    37	  definitionally (`baseChange_over_eq_snd_left`).
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft`,
    39	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsProperSndLeft`,
    40	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft` — the base-change transport of the
    41	  standing bundle onto the raw morphism `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`.
    42	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange` (item 2),
    43	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsProperBaseChange`,
    44	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instQuasiCompactBaseChange` (item 4) — the same properties in the
    45	  `↘`-spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec K` that `classDeg` queries.
    46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsIntegralBaseChange` (item 3): `C_K` is integral.
    47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange`,
    48	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange` (item 5): the two structure-sheaf
    49	  cohomology finiteness instances over `K`.
    50	
    51	The acceptance smoke test (item 6) verifies that the landed `classDeg K` typechecks on `C_K`
    52	with every hypothesis inferred by resolution.
    53	-/

    55	set_option autoImplicit false
    56	
    57	universe u
    58	
    59	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    60	
    61	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    62	
    63	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    64	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    65	  (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    66	
    67	/-! ## Item 1: the `K`-scheme structure via the second projection -/
    68	
    69	/-- **Item 1.** The base-changed curve `C_K := (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` is a scheme over
    70	`Spec K` via the **second projection** `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`. This is the same
    71	structure morphism that `Cohomology.RelativeTwoCover.relCurve.instOver` installs, but keyed on
    72	the `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` spelling consumed by the Riemann–Roch/degree stack (rather than
    73	on the `relCurve C K` `def`). -/
    74	noncomputable instance instOverBaseChange :
    75	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    76	  .ofHom (snd C (overSpec k K)).left
    77	
    78	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
    79	/-- The structure morphism installed by `instOverBaseChange` is, definitionally, the second
    80	projection `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`. This equation is `rfl`; it lets a consumer rewrite
    81	the `↘`-spelling that `classDeg` uses into the raw projection the base-change lemmas produce
    82	(and back), and pins the alignment with `relCurve.instOver`. -/
    83	theorem baseChange_over_eq_snd_left :
    84	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) = (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-! ## Transport of the standing bundle onto the raw second projection
    88	
    89	Every property is transported from `C.hom` along the base-change square
    90	`Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)`, whose right leg is the second projection. These are
    91	keyed on the raw morphism `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`, which is what the bundled curve
    92	`Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left` feeds to the landed curve-level instances
    93	(`isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced`, `moduleFinite_hModule_zero`/`_one`). -/
    94	
    95	/-- **Base change of smooth-of-relative-dimension-one.** The second projection is smooth of
    96	relative dimension one over `K`, by `smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange`. -/
    97	instance instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft :
    98	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=
    99	  haveI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1) :=
   100	    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
   101	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1)
   102	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)) inferInstance
   103	
   104	/-- **Base change of properness.** The second projection is proper over `K`
   105	(`IsProper.isStableUnderBaseChange`). -/
   106	instance instIsProperSndLeft : IsProper (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=
   107	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsProper)
   108	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)) inferInstance
   109

/-!
# The shift ε⁺ (DAT-5): the Θ-family and the multiplication-by-θ isomorphism

For the challenge curve `C` over `k`, this file packages the twist normalization
`ε⁺` of the Wave-4 datum campaign (worksheet `informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §2.4,
§4 DAT-5).  Fix a Čech Picard class `L₀` on the base-changed curve
`C_k = (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left` — the pinned Θ-class (concretely `fiberTwist π 1`,
§ below).  The deliverables:

1. **The θ-family `thetaFamily C L₀ T : picEt C T`**, natural in the test object `T`:
   the plus class over `T` obtained by pulling the base plus class
   `PicEtAff.unit C k (relPicMk C (overSpec k k) L₀)` back along the canonical
   structure map `toBaseTest T : T ⟶ overSpec k k`.  Naturality is
   `thetaFamily_natural`: `θ` pulls back to `θ` under every test map, so DAT-C/DAT-B
   twist by `θ_T ^ m` uniformly.

2. **`degAt_thetaFamily`**: `degAt (thetaFamily C L₀ T) t = classDeg k L₀` at *every*
   field point `t`, via DAT-4's `degAt_eq_classDeg_of_affineEquiv_eq_unit_baseChange`
   (base-field-invariant).  With `L₀ = thetaCechClass C = fiberTwist π 1` this constant
   is `d₁ := classDeg k (fiberTwist π 1)`, and `1 ≤ d₁` is `one_le_classDeg_thetaCechClass`
   (DAT-0b).

3. **The multiplication-by-`θ_T ^ m` natural isomorphism `mulThetaPowNatIso`**, as
   `Type`-valued functors:
   `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat ≅ picDegLayerFunctor C (m·d₁)`.
   The group structure lives **only** on the `pic0` side (worksheet §5 risk 6:
   `pic^d` is a coset, not a subgroup — `picDegLayer` is a subtype, not a subgroup).
   `representableByOfShift` transports a `RepresentableBy` datum for the shifted layer
   to one for the `pic0` functor mechanically (via `RepresentableBy.ofIso`) — the ε⁺
   shift of the final `rep` that DAT-J consumes.

/-!
# THE ABEL HOOK ON THE R2 CARRIER: `DivFamZarAff` acquires a Picard class in `picEt`

Protection `I-0492` mandates the **widened** carrier — `DivFamZarAff`, certificates over
arbitrary affine-open covers — and `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart`
(`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean`) proves the widening is *strict*: a straddling connected
divisor is certified on the widened side and on **no** chart-typed adaptation, in any degree.

Measured at HEAD before writing this file (declaration index, plus a case-insensitive grep so
that producers in suffix position are not missed — memory `I-1005`): the widened carrier had a
class map (`DivFamZarAff.picClass`) and its two naturalities, a functor (`divFunctorAff`) and a
comparison (`divFunctorToAff`) — and **zero** declarations carrying it to `PicEtAff`, `picEt`,
`relPic` or `pic0`.  The whole Abel layer (`abelDivPlus`, `abelDivAff`, `abelDiv`,
`abelDivTrans`, `chartValue`, `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`) is stated at `DivFamZar` alone
(`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`); of the 25 files mentioning `DivFamZarAff`, none composed it with
the unit of the plus construction.

That gap is why the two halves of the DD-R lane cannot meet.  `abelSigmaChart`
(`Picard/Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:205`) takes `rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D` — the
**chart-typed** functor — and composes it through `chartValueTrans`/`chartValue`/`abelDiv`.  So
the only Σ-atlas the tree can build is built from a representation of `divFunctor`, while the
carrier the human's decision mandates is `divFunctorAff`.  A widened representability datum,
had anyone one, could not have reached the atlas at all.

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffClassDegree

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance 1001] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
  (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]

theorem testIntegral : IsIntegral (relCurve C K) :=
  instIsIntegralBaseChange C K
theorem testSmooth :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C K
theorem testProper :
    IsProper (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  instIsProperBaseChange C K
theorem testQC :
    QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C K
theorem testH0 :
    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C K
theorem testH1 :
    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C K

scoped[RelativeCurve] attribute [instance 1001] AlgebraicGeometry.relCurve.instOver
scoped[RelativeCurve] attribute [instance 100] AlgebraicGeometry.testIntegral
  AlgebraicGeometry.testSmooth AlgebraicGeometry.testProper AlgebraicGeometry.testQC
  AlgebraicGeometry.testH0 AlgebraicGeometry.testH1

open scoped RelativeCurve

example : IsIntegral (relCurve C K) := by infer_instance
example : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by
  infer_instance
example : IsProper (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by infer_instance
example : QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by infer_instance
example : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0) := by
  infer_instance
example : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1) := by
  infer_instance

end AlgebraicGeometry
EOF"

/bin/bash -lc "lake env lean --stdin <<'EOF'
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

variable (C n) in
def testAbelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
  naturality T T' g := by
    ext s
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm

@[simp]
lemma testAbelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    ((testAbelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
  rfl

variable (C n) in
def testAbelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
